item.title: Brookfield Teen Has Serious Injuries In Crash
item.description: A two-vehicle crash near Laclede Tuesday night left a Brookfield teen with serious injuries. State Troopers report that at about 8:27 pm, a pick-up driven by a 16-year-old Brookfield boy was southbound at the Laclede junction at US 36, and failed to yield. item.title: City Receives Property At 821 Walnut
item.description: A property at 821 Walnut Street was turned over to the City of Chillicothe. City Administrator Roze Frampton explains. Deeded to the City, who will work towards demolition. The city expects to sell the lot after the demolition is complete, in an effort to recoup some of the expenses.

item.title: Not Guilty Following Jury Trial
item.description: A Pattonsburg woman has been found not guilty by a Livingston County Jury. The trial for Brandy Michelle Hobson included charges of child molestation, endangering the welfare of a child, and enticement. Hobson was originally charged in Daviess County, and the case was moved to Livingston County on a change of venue.
